quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型超过此前最佳模型（含集成模型）2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新 state-of-the-art BLEU 分数 [S6.SS1.p1]；在英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过此前所有已发表单模型，训练成本不到此前 state-of-the-art 模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In row (E) we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model.
claim: 模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力键维度 dk 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码得到几乎相同的结果 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，将查询与所有键做点积、除以 √dk 后经 softmax 得到值的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]；多头注意力将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力再拼接投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]，本文使用 h=8 个头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）进行预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 模型沿用 BERT 的做法，在序列前加入一个可学习的分类 token，其编码器输出状态作为图像表示 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 在自监督方面，作者初步实验显示自监督预训练相比从头训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，作者将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。

quote: However, we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
claim: 作者还指出，预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，也受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
claim: RAG 的生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.
claim: 作者指出，结合参数记忆与非参数记忆的混合模型可以解决部分问题，因为知识可以直接修订和扩展，访问的知识可以被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。

quote: Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
claim: 论文旨在解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上访问和精确操作知识能力有限、性能落后于任务特定架构的问题，以及为其决策提供来源和更新世界知识的问题 [abstract]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为不重叠的 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，使用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 此外，在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，训练了 20 至 1202 层的网络 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相似，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 作者指出，当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题：随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: We replace each 2-layer block in the 34-layer net with this 3-layer bottleneck block, resulting in a 50-layer ResNet (Table 1).
claim: 作者比较了 18 层和 34 层普通网络与残差网络，并构建了 50、101、152 层的瓶颈残差网络 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS1.p13][S4.SS1.p14]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 此外，作者提到深度普通网络优化困难的原因尚待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的平均 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: we introduce a language consistency reward during RL training, which is calculated as the proportion of target language words in the CoT
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段训练框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励以缓解语言混杂问题 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的平均 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: A similar trend is observed on coding algorithm tasks, such as LiveCodeBench and Codeforces, where reasoning-focused models dominate these benchmarks
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在编程算法任务上推理模型占优 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024)
claim: 论文在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。

quote: we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score
claim: 在测试时扩展方法比较中，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、良好扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 成绩 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
claim: 此外，作者指出能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
claim: 数据消融显示，随机选择、仅选最长或仅选最多样样本的性能都明显更差（AIME24 平均约低 30%），而全量 59K 相比 1K 并无实质增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: we generate a reasoning trace and solution using the Google Gemini Flash Thinking API
claim: 方法包含两部分：一是数据构建，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 个问题，按质量、难度、多样性三条准则筛选出 1,000 个样本构成 s1K，推理轨迹由 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏生成 [S2.SS1.p

quote: Similar improvements are observed on other challenging benchmarks such as CHMath (84.2% vs 68.5%) and GradeSchool (76.2% vs 63.8%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座模型的 45.3%；在 CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，在 GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 上达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Third, we incorporate multi-disciplinary benchmarks including Minerva (undergraduate-level STEM) and GPQA to evaluate the transfer of mathematical reasoning skills to broader contexts beyond our training domain.
claim: 实验在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 上评估，并在分布外基准 OlympiadBench、CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool、Minerva 和 GPQA 上评估 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Our primary evaluation suite includes several well-established mathematical competitions and benchmarks: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 实验在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 上评估，并在分布外基准 OlympiadBench、CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool、Minerva 和 GPQA 上评估 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: This meticulous process yields a compact yet potent dataset of just 800 training samples.
claim: 方法上，作者从大规模 QA 池出发，先进行粗粒度难度过滤，再进行细粒度难度评估和知识点多样化，同时按逻辑连贯性、步骤清晰度和解答正确性筛选推理链，最终得到 800 条训练样本 [S1.p4]。

quote: We propose the Less-Is-More Reasoning (LIMO) Hypothesis, identifying two critical factors determining the elicitation threshold for complex reasoning
claim: 作者提出 LIMO 假说，认为复杂推理的激发阈值取决于模型参数中是否潜在具备前置知识，以及少量示例能否有效示范解题过程并鼓励扩展推理 [S1.p3]。

quote: The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
claim: 其组件包括搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理，智能体在每一步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并纳入命令执行反馈 [S3.p1]。

quote: out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
claim: 智能体行为分析发现，编辑对智能体仍有挑战，2,294 个任务中有 1,185 个（51.7%）轨迹出现至少一次失败编辑，且随着失败编辑累积恢复概率下降 [S5.SS2.p4]。

quote: SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例，消融与分析在包含 300 个实例的 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，并用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。

quote: motivating the need for an agent-computer interface (ACI), i.e., an abstraction layer between the LM agent and computer
claim: 论文提出智能体-计算机接口（ACI）的概念，即语言模型智能体与计算机之间的抽象层，并构建了 SWE-agent 系统 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
claim: 作者指出，将智能体应用于软件工程这类更复杂的代码任务仍未被探索，而语言模型智能体在使用现有 Linux shell 等应用时常常难以可靠地采取行动 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K
claim: 下游评估使用 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本设置，不进行任务微调 [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence
claim: Quiet-STaR 在每对相邻 token 之间引入辅助的理由变量，目标是让模型生成中间思考以更好地预测剩余序列 [S3.p1]。

quote: We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4
claim: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型，主要在 OpenWebMath 上训练，并在 C4 上评估 [S5.p1][S5.p2]。

quote: In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
claim: Quiet-STaR 在生成每个额外 token 前需生成大量 token，带来显著开销 [S6.p2]。

quote: on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
claim: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在零样本 CommonsenseQA 上提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem.
claim: 作者对 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 在 CodeContests、MiniF2F、GSM8K、MATH 上每个问题生成 10,000 个独立样本；对 SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架，每个问题限制 250 次尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
claim: 作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展持续提升模型能力，但推理时用户和开发者常限制模型只做一次尝试 [S1.p2]。

quote: When holding the total number of inference FLOPs constant, we find that on some datasets (e.g. MATH), coverage is maximized with a smaller model and more samples, while on others (e.g CodeContests) it is better to sample fewer times from a larger model.
claim: 重复采样还能使较弱模型在固定 FLOPs 预算下超越更强模型，且在某些情况下更具成本效益 [S1.p9]。

quote: In our experiments, we explore only a simple version of repeated sampling where all attempts to a problem are generated independently of one another using the exact same prompt and hyperparameters.
claim: 作者承认实验仅探索了简单版本的重复采样，即所有尝试使用相同提示和超参数独立生成，并认为该设置可通过提高解多样性、多轮交互和从先前尝试中学习来改进 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题以正温度独立采样多个候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试）从样本中选择最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
claim: 作者还指出，少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是识别训练中已见过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在零样本、单样本和少样本三种条件下测试 [S1.p9]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模监督数据集限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需简短指令或极少量示例就能完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
claim: GPT-3 在多项任务上取得较强结果：零样本 CoQA 达 81.5 F1，少样本达 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；TriviaQA 少样本达 71.2%，在闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到当时最优 [S1.p11]。

quote: GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning
claim: 评估时不做梯度更新或微调，而是通过文本交互给出任务描述和少量示例，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: we acknowledge that the numbers in this section are not reproducible externally
claim: 此外，安全基准是 Meta 内部的，作者承认这些数字无法在外部复现 [S5.SS4.SSS4.p2]。

quote: We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks.
claim: 多模态实验表明，组合式方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上表现与最先进水平具有竞争力 [abstract]。

quote: Llama 3 also delivers a much better balance between helpfulness and harmlessness than its predecessor.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: We leverage MMLU and MMLU-Pro to evaluate Llama 3’s capability on knowledge-based question answering.
claim: 后训练模型在 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、IFEval、HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E、MGSM 等基准上进行了评估 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS3.p2][S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。

quote: Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
claim: 视觉编码器重新设计 ViT，采用 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生分辨率并加速计算，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 作者指出，在将 Chain-of-Thought 推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管采取了过滤策略，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的目标是探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).
claim: 在 GUI 基准 ScreenSpot Pro 上取得 43.6% 准确率，远超 Aguvis-72B 的 23.6% 和 Qwen2-VL-72B 的 1.6% [S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: We use the Flow Matching framework to train our joint image and video generation model.
